result.verdict: promoted to tasks.json (priority 57). Stacks additively on Direction 3.

hypothesis: Re-ranking the top-k leaf candidates with ColBERT-style late interaction (token-level MaxSim between query and tool description) recovers misses where the correct tool is in the candidate set but ranked below k.

paper.title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT
paper.key_claim: Late-interaction multi-vector scoring is two orders of magnitude faster than full cross-encoders while preserving most of the quality.

baseline.miss_breakdown: 27/180 misses; ~89% descend correct L1 / wrong L2

design.stage: post-traversal reranker between retrieve() and the returned top-k
design.scoring: Sum over query tokens of max cosine to tool-description tokens (MaxSim).
design.embedder: Reuse text-embedding-3-large at sentence granularity first (cheap variant); upgrade to token-level only if sentence variant moves the needle.
design.scope: Only fire when len(candidates) > k; pull candidates = top-(2*k) from traverser, rerank to k.
files_to_touch: src/tool_index/retrieval/traverser.py (extend retrieve to return top-2k when rerank=True)

measurement.metric: recall@10 on the 180-query synthetic eval set

risks: Embedding cost: token-level requires per-token vectors for every tool; may need a separate cheaper embedder.
Rerank can only help if the right tool is already in candidates — bounded by traverser recall@(2k).
decision_rule: Promote to tasks.json if recall@10 >= 0.94 and latency budget acceptable; otherwise archive with measurement notes.
